The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is equipped in the {{Icon|pickaxe}} slot and is used when collecting stone, clearing debris and [[mining]] deposits.  The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} can be found in the [[Graveyard]] [[Trunk]] and bought from the [[Blacksmith]].

Efficiency reflects how much progress toward a task each use of a tool provides. An efficiency of 100% would be full speed, 200% would be double speed, and 50% would be half speed. The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is 70% efficient.

Energy usage reflects how much energy each action consumes. The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} consumes {{Energy||1}} per swing.

Studying {{PAGENAME}} at the [[Study table]] will give you {{Techpoint|Red|10}}.
